messages.subject: Prediction of the response
parts:
Dear INLA group members,

I am modelling fish catches and I have the vessels as a random effect. We have also these vessels grouped accordingly to their tonnage in 3 levels (assuming 3 different mean tonnage values). I wanted to predict the response but I do not have the locations of the vessels at the prediction grid. My question is, is there a way of making predictions of the response assuming 3 cases, one assuming that at the prediction grid all vessels have a certain tonnage, another assuming that all vessels have another tonnage and so on? If so, can you help me?

Kind regards,
Lídia
